notes.title: Update notes for 1.7.
notes.content:
I'm very excited to announce several changes, and... a planned gameplay mode that will come later this autumn!



First, here are some important changes in version 1.7: 

More skeletons in the castle, and outside the castle, if you make it there.. :)

More traversal challenges outside the castle (hope you're not afraid of heights..!)

In the main menu you can check out the news section where planned updates will be described.

Design changes to the main menu including level progress doors that you unlock as you make your way through the castle. 
Planned gameplay mode: Tower Defense Mode
I'm super excited to announce a planned gameplay update! For the next major version, the Tower Defense Mode will be introduced!

Read more here: https://theindirectcastleretreat.com/tower-defense-mode/

Here's the news screenshot from in-game. You can sign up for the updates newsletter where all published updates will be announced as well.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45312753/b30f2839dceb3b65b931960ea4f403c4e61dbba1.png"]

notes.title: Update notes for version 1.6.2
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45312753/9dbba938652489cc52e49150f2b2cd49eb2f2379.png"]- Created new collectible icons.

- Added more ghosts and medieval soldiers in linear challenges.

- Another ghost battle added.

- Added a clue in the dancing hall.

- Informational message displayed in opening scene after the player is knocked out.

- Music added to starting game (whether you start from scratch or a saved game).

- Punching ability updated for player.

- Fixed crouching camera distance.

- Improved the location of the "saving game" text to show game progression as the player progresses in the story.

- Controls image updated: Inventory (I) button is also pause, and that is highlighted in the controls screen that is accessible from the main menu.

- Game menu shows the empty progress image holders for the levels.



Wishlist now to be notified of future updates!
